title: PeakGuideR workflow
text: morph_results useful want see individual isotope-morphology candidate pairs detected carbon isotope-ratio elemental isotope-pattern validation applied. Useful columns include: idx_M0, mz_M0: index m/z anchor (candidate monoisotopic) feature. iso_type: isotope type candidate pair (C13_M1, C13_M2, N15_M1, O18_M2, S34_M2, Cl37_M2 Br81_M2). element: element associated isotope type (C, N, O, S, Cl Br). k: isotope level (1 2). z: charge state (always 1). idx_cand, mz_cand: index m/z candidate isotope feature. score_global: spatial/intensity morphology similarity score anchor candidate features. tile_summary, tile_sd, tile_consistency: tile-level summary, standard deviation consistency morphology score across spatial subregions. score_final: blended score combining score_global tile_consistency. mass_err_da, mass_err_ppm: candidate mass error versus theoretical isotope mass difference, Da ppm. mass_dev_err, mass_dev_score: absolute mass error corresponding continuous mass-deviation score.
code: res$morph_results |>   dplyr::select(     idx_M0,     mz_M0,     iso_type,     element,     idx_cand,     mz_cand,     score_global,     tile_consistency,     score_final,     mass_err_ppm,     mass_dev_score   ) |>   head()

title: PeakGuideR workflow
text: cir_results useful want see C13 M+1 candidates morph_results also supported observed carbon isotope ratio. Useful columns include: idx_M0, mz_M0: index m/z candidate monoisotopic (M+0) feature. idx_M1, mz_M1: index m/z candidate C13 M+1 isotope feature. R_obs: observed M+1/M+0 intensity ratio. R_theo: theoretical carbon isotope ratio expected monoisotopic m/z. cir_rel_err: relative error R_obs R_theo. is_valid_c13_raw: whether cir_rel_err cir_rel_tol, chained-isotope filtering. cir_score: continuous isotope-ratio agreement score. cir_class: qualitative agreement class ("high_agreement", "moderate_agreement" "low_agreement"). is_chained_c13: whether M+0 feature already valid M+1 another pair (chained-isotope artefact). is_valid_c13: final validity, .e. is_valid_c13_raw chained. has_C13_M2: whether supporting C13 M+2 candidate also found M+0. idx_C13_M2, mz_C13_M2, score_C13_M2: index, m/z morphology score supporting C13 M+2 feature, has_C13_M2 TRUE.
code: res$cir_results |>   dplyr::select(     idx_M0,     mz_M0,     idx_M1,     mz_M1,     R_obs,     R_theo,     cir_rel_err,     cir_score,     cir_class,     is_valid_c13,     has_C13_M2   ) |>   head()

"dp": find candidates within ±tol_dp data points ordered mass axis. Preprocessing steps per intensity pair: Keep pixels features detected (x!=0 & y!=0) #' 2. Apply feature-wise low-intensity quantile filters retained pixels. Pixels kept features respective threshold. Optionally clip negatives (clip_negatives=TRUE). Apply intensity transform (none, log1p, zscore). Scoring metrics considered setting transformation method: zscore recommended pearson correlation, log1p none cosine similarity none spearman. Normalization can applied (e.g. TIC) considered regarding result interpretation. Scoring metrics (method): "pearson": squared Pearson correlation (R²), 0 1. "cosine": cosine similarity. "spearman": squared Spearman rank correlation (negatives set 0). Tile mode: use_tiles=TRUE pixel coordinates present (pkm$pos$x,y), sample split approximately sqrt(tiles)×sqrt(tiles) subregions. tile, correlation computed, summarizing via: "median": median tile scores, "p25": 25th percentile (robust lower-bound), "pass_rate": fraction tiles score ≥ tile_threshold. consistency factor computed : $$ tile\_consistency = \max(0, 1 - sd(tile\_scores)) $$ final score blends global morphology score tile-consistency factor: $$score\_final = \alpha \cdot score\_global + (1-\alpha) \cdot tile\_consistency$$ tile_alpha parameter controls contribution global score relative tile-consistency component. selected tile_blend summary returned tile_summary inspection.
